title: Mining Levels
description: Souls of Avarice runs a fifteen-rung mining ladder, eleven rungs past vanilla's netherite. One quest per rung.
Each is satisfied by holding a Smithery tool whose head material reaches that level - build it however you like. Higher materials always count for lower rungs.

quests.title: Fragile (0)
description: Forge a Smithery tool whose head material reaches mining level Fragile (0).
6 materials sit at this level: Basalt, Blood, Clay, Glowstone, Lava, Slime.
Any head material at or above Fragile (0) counts. Only the head decides mining level; handles and bindings do not.
